nodes.label: The signed orientation trace (Item 1 / G5b closed as derived)
nodes.rationale: The instrument symmetrises M while the filed law evaluated T on the endpoint, so their difference is half the oriented asymmetry per endpoint, weighted by occupancy and averaged over the two endpoints. Verified by receipt arithmetic only (w104c-58.json, no solve): 6s and 5s ratios 0.999992 and 1.000103, residuals three orders below the object.
